summary: Frontend-only retest of discoverability fix for (1) restaurant name setting and (2) Esaurito checkbox. All 4 requested scenarios PASS. Wine form: at 1920x800 the Esaurito checkbox (y=521) and Visibile switch (y=620) are inside the first viewport, right under the label photo; at 390x844 they are at y=506/606, above the Nome input (y=710), without scrolling. Creating TEST_ wine with Esaurito checked -> POST 201 esaurito=true, wine-soldout-badge-<id> visible on card, detail-soldout-badge visible, edit dialog reopens with checkbox data-state=checked. /carta (admin): carta-restaurant-section directly under the page header (y=256 desktop, input y=392 mobile); save updates carta-restaurant-name + brand-restaurant-name (desktop) and mobile-restaurant-name (390px header); toast 'Nome del ristorante salvato'. /account restaurant-card prefilled with the saved value, save works, clearing falls back to 'Ristorante'/'Selezione'. Staff user: carta-restaurant-section and restaurant-card both absent (count 0). No horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth 390 on /carta, dialog 388/388).
critical_code_review_comments: RestaurantForm useEffect only initialises once after load. If the name is saved in another tab, an already mounted form won't refresh. Acceptable, low priority.
